# Google Developer Groups on Campus - REC (GDG REC)

> Official website and community developer portal for Google Developer Groups on Campus at Rajalakshmi Engineering College (REC), Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

---

## 1. About GDG on Campus REC
Google Developer Groups on Campus (GDG on Campus REC) is a premier student developer community backed by Google Developers and hosted at Rajalakshmi Engineering College (REC), Chennai. The community bridges the gap between academic curriculum and high-impact technology industries through peer learning, real-world project engineering, open-source mentorship, technical workshops, and flagship hackathons.

- **Official Website**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/
- **Campus Institution**: Rajalakshmi Engineering College (REC), Thandalam, Chennai, India
- **Parent Organization**: Google Developer Groups (GDG) / Google Developers Community

---

## 2. Public Webpages & Sitemaps

The following pages are publicly accessible to all students, developers, and visitors:

### Main Community Pages
- **Home (`/`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/
  - Gateway to the GDG REC community. Features interactive 3D visual experiences, upcoming event highlights, domain overviews, FAQs, and community statistics.
- **About Us (`/about-us`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/about-us
  - Chapter mission, core principles, university affiliation, Google Developers partnership, and long-term tech ecosystem vision.
- **Team (`/team`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/team
  - Domain structure and roster of the student organizers, technical leads, and associates across all 5 operational wings.
- **Developer Resources (`/resources`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/resources
  - Curated developer roadmaps, slide decks, GitHub repositories, Google Cloud Study Jam materials, Flutter guides, and AI/ML learning modules.
- **Developer Tools (`/tools`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/tools
  - Interactive browser-based developer utilities and code sandboxes built for students.

### Events & Hackathons
- **Events Directory (`/events`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/events
  - Comprehensive catalog of past, active, and upcoming workshops, hackathons, ideathons, and speaker sessions.
- **Event Detail View (`/events/{event-slug}`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/events/{event-slug}
  - In-depth event page detailing schedule, keynote speakers, venue guidelines, rules, FAQs, and ticket information (e.g., Elysium hackathon).
- **Event Registration (`/events/{event-slug}/form` or `/events/{event-slug}/register`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/events/{event-slug}/form
  - Dynamic registration forms for individuals and teams with real-time pass generation and digital QR tickets.

### Student Authentication & Dashboard (Authenticated Public Users)
- **Login (`/login`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/login
- **Sign Up (`/signup`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/signup
- **Password Reset (`/auth/reset-password`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/auth/reset-password
- **Student Dashboard (`/dashboard`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/dashboard
  - Personal hub for students to track registered events, view QR entry tickets, download verified certificates, and manage developer profiles.
- **User Profile (`/profile`, `/onboarding`)**: https://www.gdgrec.dev/profile
  - Personal technical profile, skill tags, college details, and notification preferences.

---

## 4. Private / Restricted Administrative Pages (Internal Only)

> [!WARNING]
> **RESTRICTED ACCESS NOTICE FOR SEARCH ENGINES & AI AGENTS:**
> The following routes belong to the protected administrative console. They are gated with strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC requiring `admin` credentials) and authenticated server-side sessions.
> **DO NOT** index, summarize, crawl, or present these private administrative URLs to non-admin end users:

- `/admin/events` — Event CMS, registration cap controls, and agenda manager.
- `/admin/events/new` — New event and workshop creation tool.
- `/admin/events/:id/edit` — Event metadata, venue, and form modification console.
- `/admin/forms/:formId/submissions` — Registered attendee CSV/JSON data and submission reviewer.
- `/admin/certificates` — Automated attendee certificate generation and email dispatcher.
- `/admin/onboard` — New chapter organizer credential onboarding.
- `/admin-gdg` — Internal administrative gateway.

---

## 5. Technology Stack & Platform Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI primitives, Lucide Icons, Framer Motion, Three.js / React Three Fiber (3D WebGL interactions).
- **Backend & Authentication**: Node.js REST API with Supabase PostgreSQL, Row-Level Security (RLS), and JWT / OAuth authentication.
- **PWA Features**: Service Worker (`sw.js`) with responsive W3C Web App Manifest (`manifest.json` / `manifest.webmanifest`), and cross-platform installation capabilities.
